metadata.description: Ice breaker games organized by SessionLab categories

meeting_icebreakers.name: Meeting Icebreakers
meeting_icebreakers.description: Perfect for starting team meetings and helping participants mentally arrive

games.title: What Are You Bringing to the Meeting?
games.description: A mindful check-in where participants write down worries and energy levels, then set them aside for better focus
games.steps:
Step 1: Ask participants to check-in with themselves
Step 2: Write down worries, energy levels, and thoughts
Step 3: Put these aside for the meeting duration
Step 4: Share how they're feeling if comfortable

games.title: Rock Paper Scissors Tournament
games.description: Traditional game with a twist - losers become fans who cheer for remaining players
games.steps:
Step 1: Everyone pairs up for Rock Paper Scissors
Step 2: Losers become fans of winners
Step 3: Winners continue playing while fans cheer
Step 4: Continue until final two players remain

games.title: Weather Check-in
games.description: Share feelings using weather metaphors for a quick group sentiment check
games.steps:
Step 1: Ask each person to describe their current feeling as weather
Step 2: Examples: 'sunny skies with rain clouds looming'
Step 3: Go around the group quickly
Step 4: Acknowledge the group's overall 'weather'

games.title: Have You Ever? (Stand Up If)
games.description: Participants stand if they can answer yes to 'Have you ever...' questions
games.steps:
Step 1: Ask 'Have you ever...' questions
Step 2: Participants stand if answer is yes
Step 3: Those standing can ask the next question
Step 4: Continue with 5-8 questions

games.title: 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding Technique
games.description: Mindful exercise engaging all senses to help participants be present
games.steps:
Step 1: Name 5 things you can see
Step 2: Name 4 things you can touch
Step 3: Name 3 things you can hear
Step 4: Name 2 things you can smell
Step 5: Name 1 thing you can taste

quick_5_minute_icebreakers.name: Quick 5-Minute Icebreakers
quick_5_minute_icebreakers.description: Fast activities perfect for tight agendas and quick warm-ups

games.title: One Word at a Time
games.description: Groups create sentences by contributing one word each while going around the circle
games.steps:
Step 1: Give a topic or starting word
Step 2: Go around circle, each person adds one word
Step 3: Try to create a complete sentence
Step 4: Speed up or add challenges for fun

games.title: Count Up
games.description: Group counts sequentially without speaking over each other or establishing patterns
games.steps:
Step 1: Set a target number (like 20)
Step 2: Count from 1 without overlapping or patterns
Step 3: If two speak at once, start over
Step 4: Celebrate when target is reached

games.title: Apple, Orange and Banana
games.description: Physical energizer where participants move based on called fruit names
games.steps:
Step 1: Stand in circle, hands on shoulders of person in front
Step 2: Apple = move forward, Orange = backward, Banana = spin
Step 3: Call out fruits, group responds
Step 4: Mix it up with multiple commands

games.title: Name Game
games.description: Learn names by repeating previous names before adding your own
games.steps:
Step 1: Sit in circle where everyone can see each other
Step 2: First person says their name
Step 3: Next person repeats first name, then adds theirs
Step 4: Continue building the chain around circle

games.title: Line Up
games.description: Non-verbal challenge to arrange in order by given criteria without speaking
games.steps:
Step 1: Announce ordering criteria (height, birthday, etc.)
Step 2: Participants arrange themselves without speaking
Step 3: Check the final order
Step 4: Debrief on non-verbal communication strategies

fun_icebreakers.name: Fun Icebreakers
fun_icebreakers.description: Entertaining activities that strengthen bonds and create inclusive atmosphere

games.title: Portrait Gallery
games.description: Teams create quick portraits of each other by rotating artists every 15 seconds
games.steps:
Step 1: Split into Team A (subjects) and Team B (artists)
Step 2: Artists draw for 15 seconds, then rotate
Step 3: Continue until everyone has drawn everyone
Step 4: Display the collaborative portraits

games.title: Minefield
games.description: Blindfolded participants navigate obstacles guided by teammates' voices
games.steps:
Step 1: Set up harmless obstacles on floor
Step 2: Participants take turns being blindfolded
Step 3: Teammates guide them through the course
Step 4: Debrief on communication and trust

games.title: Crazy Handshake
games.description: Pairs create unique handshakes and teach them to others in rotating partnerships
games.steps:
Step 1: Pairs introduce themselves and create a handshake
Step 2: Split and partner with someone new
Step 3: Teach original handshakes and create new one
Step 4: Repeat and share all learned handshakes

games.title: The Movie Pitch Icebreaker
games.description: Small groups create and pitch original movie ideas based on themes
games.steps:
Step 1: Form small groups and give theme
Step 2: Create movie title, plot, and cast
Step 3: Present pitch to group as if selling to studio
Step 4: Optional voting on best pitch

games.title: Bang!
games.description: Fast-paced elimination game with sheriff pointing and quick reactions
games.steps:
Step 1: Stand in circle with one person as sheriff in middle
Step 2: Sheriff points at someone who must quickly crouch
Step 3: People on either side must 'draw' weapons quickly
Step 4: Slowest person becomes new sheriff

virtual_icebreakers.name: Virtual Icebreakers
virtual_icebreakers.description: Activities designed specifically for online meetings and remote teams

games.title: Take a Picture of Your Shoes
games.description: Everyone shares a photo of their current shoes and tells the story behind them
games.steps:
Step 1: Ask everyone to take a photo of their shoes
Step 2: Share photos via screen share or chat
Step 3: Each person explains their shoe choice
Step 4: Optional: vote on most interesting pair

games.title: Chat Waterfall
games.description: Everyone types answers simultaneously then sends all at once creating a 'waterfall' effect
games.steps:
Step 1: Ask a question like 'favorite snack'
Step 2: Everyone types answer but doesn't send
Step 3: On count of 3, everyone sends at once
Step 4: Enjoy the waterfall of responses

games.title: Emoji Check-In
games.description: Participants express their mood or energy using only emojis
games.materials: Video platform with emoji reactions or chat
games.steps:
Step 1: Ask everyone to choose emojis for their current mood
Step 2: Share via reactions or chat
Step 3: Optional: explain emoji choices briefly
Step 4: Acknowledge the group's overall energy

games.title: Remote Change 3 Things
games.description: One person changes 3 things about appearance/background while camera is off
games.steps:
Step 1: One participant turns off camera
Step 2: They change 3 small things (glasses, hat, background)
Step 3: Turn camera back on
Step 4: Others guess what changed

get_to_know_each_other.name: Get to Know Each Other
get_to_know_each_other.description: Activities focused on building personal connections and learning about team members

games.title: Two Truths and One Lie
games.description: Classic game where participants share two truths and one lie about themselves
games.steps:
Step 1: Each person prepares two truths and one lie
Step 2: Share all three statements
Step 3: Group votes on which is the lie
Step 4: Reveal answer and discuss interesting truths

games.title: Diversity Bingo
games.description: Bingo cards with statements about experiences - find people who match each square
games.steps:
Step 1: Create 3x3 bingo cards with experience statements
Step 2: Mingle to find people who match statements
Step 3: Get signatures for matches
Step 4: Share interesting discoveries

games.title: Unique and Shared
games.description: Small groups discover commonalities and unique characteristics of each member
games.steps:
Step 1: Form groups of 4-5 people
Step 2: Find things everyone has in common
Step 3: Identify unique characteristics of each person
Step 4: Share findings with larger group

games.title: Speed Dating Icebreaker
games.description: Rapid succession of short conversations to maximize networking
games.steps:
Step 1: Arrange chairs in pairs
Step 2: Set 3-minute timer for each conversation
Step 3: Focus on professional information exchange
Step 4: Rotate partners when timer rings

team_building_deep_connection.name: Team Building & Deep Connection
team_building_deep_connection.description: Activities for building stronger team bonds and deeper relationships

games.title: Coat of Arms
games.description: Create personal coat of arms with sections representing work, values, and aspirations
games.steps:
Step 1: Draw coat of arms with 5 sections
Step 2: Fill sections with work role, hobby, achievement, value, aspiration
Step 3: Pair with person you know least
Step 4: Present partner's coat of arms to group

games.title: Four Quadrants Activity
games.description: Share four things about yourself through simple drawings in quadrants
games.steps:
Step 1: Draw four quadrants on paper
Step 2: Fill each with simple drawing representing different aspects
Step 3: Share drawings and explain meanings
Step 4: Display all quadrants together

games.title: Back to Back Drawing
games.description: Communication exercise where one person describes image for partner to draw
games.steps:
Step 1: Pairs sit back to back
Step 2: One person receives image to describe
Step 3: Partner draws based only on verbal instructions
Step 4: Compare final drawing to original image

large_group_activities.name: Large Group Activities
large_group_activities.description: Icebreakers designed for big groups and events

games.title: Group Map
games.description: Participants position themselves on imaginary world map based on where they grew up
games.steps:
Step 1: Designate room as world map
Step 2: Participants position themselves by birthplace/hometown
Step 3: Share briefly about their location
Step 4: Optional: share a value learned from that place

games.title: Passions Tic Tac Toe
games.description: Fill tic-tac-toe grid with passions, then find others with matching interests
games.steps:
Step 1: Fill 3x3 grid with personal passions
Step 2: Mingle to find others with same passions
Step 3: Get signatures for matching squares
Step 4: First to get three in a row wins

teamwork_improvement.name: Teamwork Improvement
teamwork_improvement.description: Games specifically designed to enhance collaboration and team dynamics

games.title: Marshmallow Challenge
games.description: Build tallest tower using spaghetti, tape, string with marshmallow on top
games.steps:
Step 1: Form teams of 4-5 people
Step 2: Build tallest free-standing structure
Step 3: Marshmallow must be on top
Step 4: Measure and celebrate tallest tower

games.title: Helium Stick
games.description: Team must lower a stick to ground while everyone keeps finger contact
games.steps:
Step 1: Line up in two rows facing each other
Step 2: Place stick on everyone's index fingers
Step 3: Lower stick to ground without losing contact
Step 4: Restart if anyone loses contact

games.title: Desert Island
games.description: Group decides which items to keep for survival on desert island
games.steps:
Step 1: Present list of available items
Step 2: Group must agree on limited number to keep
Step 3: Discuss and negotiate priorities
Step 4: Debrief on decision-making process
